review.reason: Codex-assisted implementation review: this genuine revised PR patch applies String() to each template substitution before calling the unchanged regular escape/unescape functions. It preserves literal segments and the regular string-only API. Actual baseline fails tag coercion; this candidate passes tag behavior, ordinary string/one-pass-unescape preservation and regular-method rejection. Original source is preserved. Assessment covers this pinned three-check recipe and examined diff; AVA/TypeScript suites were not executed.

task_text: Allow htmlEscapeTag and htmlUnescapeTag to interpolate non-string values by converting each substitution with String before escaping or unescaping it. Preserve ordinary string escaping/unescaping and the existing string-only behavior of htmlEscape and htmlUnescape; the regular functions must not acquire implicit non-string coercion. Preserve literal template segments.
